name: DownloadPlus Fx136
description: Enhances Firefox/Zen downloads with external download manager integration, Aria2 RPC support, rename and save options. Sine patch waits for browser delayed startup before registering the toolbar button, adds Zen-compatible CustomizableUI imports, isolates toolbar menu setup failures, syncs DownloadPlus into the navigation bar customization state, and directly inserts a fallback toolbar button when Zen skips widget instantiation.
